title: Artificial Intelligence Can Emulate Human Normative Judgments on Emotional Visual Scenes
reasoning: The paper focuses on affective computing, specifically evaluating how well multimodal LLMs can emulate human emotional ratings (valence, arousal, and discrete emotions) of images. While it mentions alignment with 'human normative values' to mitigate bias, the 'normative' here refers to population-average emotional responses rather than ethical or moral norms, and the paper does not benchmark religious or ethical reasoning.
